sources.title: Models – Codex
sources.notes: Codex CLI/app default ("Power") tier is gpt-5.6-sol at medium reasoning; Luna requires opening "Advanced" settings. Max mode is a separate opt-in toggle ("If you don't see Max in your options, you'll have to enable it in your app settings... most tasks do not need Max or Ultra"). Recommends Sol as the safe default and Luna only for "specific, high-volume tasks where you know what success looks like."

sources.title: DeepSWE Leaderboard

sources.title: codex debug models (live auth-scoped catalog)
sources.notes: Command: `codex debug models` (installed @openai/codex CLI, node 24.19.0 vendor build), run locally 2026-09-05. Live query of the installed Codex CLI (@openai/codex, node 24.19.0 vendor build) on Tim's host. Lists gpt-6-astra (new, default medium, visibility=list) and adds an `ultra` reasoning level to gpt-6-astra, gpt-5.6-sol and gpt-5.6-terra; gpt-5.6-luna does NOT list ultra. gpt-5.6-sol default_reasoning_level is `low` here, not medium. Auth-scoped: availability reflects this account, so treat as host-local evidence rather than a universal vendor claim.

sources.title: Live verification that Codex honors reasoning effort `ultra`
sources.notes: Command: `codex exec --skip-git-repo-check -c model_reasoning_effort=ultra --model gpt-5.6-terra`, run locally 2026-09-05. Ran `codex exec --skip-git-repo-check -c model_reasoning_effort=ultra --model gpt-5.6-terra` — completed a turn (14,330 tokens). Control with model_reasoning_effort=bogus on the same command returned HTTP 400, which rules out the value being silently ignored/defaulted. Establishes `ultra` is accepted by the CLI config surface, not only advertised by the catalog API.

sources.title: Models – Codex (learn.chatgpt.com)
sources.notes: NOTE: developers.openai.com/codex/models now 308-redirects here; the old SOURCES url for openai-codex-models-2026-08-02 is stale. Documents gpt-6-astra (Astra, GPT-6) with reasoning levels Low/Medium/High/Extra High/Max/Ultra, default Medium, positioned "Our most capable model for complex work across code, apps, and research". Ultra: "Ultra mode goes beyond a single-agent run. It uses subagents to accelerate complex work, making it useful for larger tasks that can be split across subagents." Recommended default tier: "Terra or Sol, depending on task complexity." Docs list Ultra for sol/terra/luna as well, which DISAGREES with this host's live `codex debug models` (luna lacks ultra; sol default=low). Treat docs as the vendor claim and the live catalog as auth-scoped availability.

sources.title: Pricing – Codex (credit rates)
sources.notes: Credit rates per 1M tokens. gpt-6-astra 250 in / 25 cached / 1250 out. gpt-5.6-sol 100/10/500 with the note "GPT-5.6 Sol's promotional pricing is available at least through November 21, 2026" — a RATE CUT vs the 250/25/1500 recorded in codex-credits-2026-07. terra 50/5/300, luna 5/0.5/30. "Fast mode applies a 2.5x multiplier to Astra's Standard rate." Page does NOT state whether reasoning effort changes the per-token RATE or only token volume — recorded as unknown, not assumed. USD/MTok not published on this page (separate rate cards by plan).

sources.title: Pricing – Anthropic
sources.notes: Verified directly by this session (not only by a delegated researcher). Sonnet 5 intro pricing made PERMANENT: "the previously scheduled increase to $3/$15 ... on September 1, 2026 will not occur." Fable/Mythos 5.1 cache reads are 0.025x base ($0.25/MTok) vs the standard 0.1x. Claude Code effort levels are low/medium/high/xhigh/max — there is NO ultra; "ultracode" is a Claude Code orchestration setting that sends xhigh, not a sixth effort level.

sources.title: Models – xAI
sources.notes: Verified directly by this session. grok-4.6: 2.00 in / 0.50 cached / 6.00 out, 500k context (SMALLER than grok-4.3/4.20 at 1M), knowledge cutoff 2026-02-01. All models carry a >=200k tier doubling input and output. Page states no explicit GA/deprecation status for any model.
